formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P8-R2 — Era×Composition Zero-Support Reconstitution, Minimum-Geometry-Support Threshold Sweep, Dominant-Cell Leverage Deletion, Full-Range Sign Bounds, R1 Era-Aggregation Repair & TS–H1 Temporal-Instability Audit

known_r1_accounting_issue.description: R1 era_reports iterated only parent-Court groups, but parent axis_report materializes groups only for sample-observed classes. Therefore zero-sample population cells were absent from R1 era denominators.

primary_readouts: true era population denominator from parent population_counts, including zero-sample cells
sample-supported population mass and full-range [-1,17/18] adversarial sign bound within each era
minimum geometry-support threshold sweep at sample_n >= 1,2,3,5
cell leverage ranked by absolute population-share-times-cell-mean contribution
leave-one-supported-cell-out era means and adversarial bounds
R1 era-sign classification before versus repaired classification
adjudication: A supported-cell negative mean with an adversarial full-era interval crossing zero is UNIDENTIFIED, not negative population sign.
A sign that disappears or becomes unidentified after requiring sample_n >=3 is sparse-cell sensitive.
TS temporal instability requires at least one era with an identified nonpositive full-era sign after zero-support repair; supported-cell negativity alone is insufficient.
H1 method-composition sensitivity from CFOP deletion remains a separate P8-R1 result and is not erased by era repair.
No temporal pattern is interpreted as cognitive change without independent evidence.
